the autono mous organization of education “ Nazarbayev University ” (hereinafter referred to as the Policy and Procedures) establishes general principles and procedures for Student Mobility at the autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev University”. 1.2. These Policy and Procedure s apply to all students participating in mobility programs, both incoming and outgoing. The Policy and Procedure s are intended for the use by students, academic and administrative staff involved in the implementation of Student Mobility. Section 2. Terms / Definitions 2.1. Main Provisions 3.1. General Regulations 3.1.1. NU is committed to equality of opportunities and merit -based selection of students. Mobility programs are available to all student s, regardless of funding source or citizenship. Participation in various types of Student Mobility is subject to

to all student s, regardless of funding source or citizenship. Participation in various types of Student Mobility is subject to meeting eligibility criteria stated in items 3.5.1. and 3.6.1. of th ese Policy and Procedures and conditions of particular types of Student Mobility. 3.1.2. Student Mobility is organized in accordance with inter -institutional or/and inter-governmental agreements and other relevant documents (fee-based contract with Partner Institution or fee-based agreement with individual applicant). 3.1.3. NU may consider full or partial funding of Student Mobility on a case – by–case basis depending on the availability of funds at NU Schools. 3.1.4. Issues not

NU recognizes the value of Student Mobility to the overall academic, professional, cultural, and personal d evelopment of students. Student Mobility experiences offer NU students various opportunities, including expanding their academic learning, developing cultural and global competencies that contribute to their acquisition of NU graduate attributes, enriching their professional learning and skills, enhancing personal development encompassing

competencies that contribute to their acquisition of NU graduate attributes, enriching their professional learning and skills, enhancing personal development encompassing leadership abilities, social awareness, and global citizenship, and ultimately improving their employment prospects. 3.1.6. NU offers a range of Student Mobility experiences, listed in item 3.1.9. of these Policy and Procedures , offered by NU Schools, Partner Institutions, or independent providers. Students may also find opportunities for mobility outside of those provided by N U. Providing students with opportunities for academically relevant mobility experiences as part of their study is an additional incentive opportunity provided by NU. 3.1.8. In cases where credits earned at a Host Institution are transferred and counted toward degree completion at NU, this must be done in accordance with these Policy and Procedures. 3.1.9.
